description: This file implements a Named Entity Recognition (NER) service using spaCy, including functions for extracting entities, factual claims, numbers with context, splitting text into claims, and finding entities within text. It defines the NERService class and manages lazy loading of the spaCy model.

classes.name: NERService
classes.description: A class providing methods for named entity recognition, extracting factual claims, numbers, and matching entities within text.

methods.name: _get_spacy
methods.description: Lazy loads the spaCy model, downloading it if necessary.

methods.name: extract_entities
methods.description: Extracts named entities from input text.

methods.name: extract_factual_claims
methods.description: Extracts sentences containing factual claims such as entities, numbers, or dates.

methods.name: extract_numbers_with_context
methods.description: Extracts numbers from text along with surrounding context.

methods.name: split_into_claims
methods.description: Splits text into individual claim-like statements, handling conjunctions.

methods.name: find_entity_in_text
methods.description: Finds an entity mention in text, with optional fuzzy matching.

methods.name: get_ner_service
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the NERService class.
